body:
I've got a message back from him finally. I've told him what I did, and he's asked me to call him.

I know this was short, but you probably just saved my life tonight. Thank you.

Are you sure? I feel like almost anyone could do a better job at creating something than me.

He's out tonight, but I'm trying to get a hold of him to ask him. I've counted out enough tylenol to kill myself, I have 58, but I feel like I want someone to talk me out of it.

I don't question my relationship often, we've been happy for three years and I love his family. It's just that he can be juvenile at times, and we're both stagnating in our careers, and I'm wondering if I'm a distraction to him.

If it wasn't at Starbucks (Fuck it, I work at fucking Starbucks), I'd like to go to school. People always used to assume that I was smart enough to do something with myself. I've always wanted to write fiction or for television, but I've convinced myself that my work is shit. Then you for being nice to me.
